shellCommands.command: cat package.json && git diff package.json && ls -a && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v .git/ | head -50 && ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/
cat next.config.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/lib/auth.ts tsconfig.json; grep -ril "forbidden" node_modules/next/dist/docs/
cd /workspace; grep -n -A25 "## Status codes" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/loading.md; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -i next

npx next build 2>&1 | tail -25 && (npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 5 && curl -s -o /tmp/admin.html -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3123/admin && grep -o '403

\|Access forbidden\|noindex' /tmp/admin.html | sort -u; pkill -f "next start" ; true
git checkout tsconfig.json; pgrep -f "next start" || echo stopped; git status --short
ps -p 374 -o pid,cmd; pkill -f "next-server|next start"; sleep 1; pgrep -fa "next" || echo none
